# FlashEx

> FlashEx turns natural-language hardware ideas into ready-to-run Arduino project scaffolds.

## Product

FlashEx is an open-source developer tool for Arduino IDE 2.x. It uses AI-assisted planning to create a project workspace, write an Arduino sketch, and install the Arduino CLI cores and libraries needed by the requested setup.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://flashex.vercel.app/): Product overview, browser demo, and installation flow.
- [Privacy Policy](https://flashex.vercel.app/privacy-policy.html): Data handling and privacy information.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://flashex.vercel.app/terms.html): Usage terms and product limitations.
- [Licenses](https://flashex.vercel.app/licenses.html): Open-source and dependency licensing notes.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/SubhakarKaarthi/flashex/blob/main/README.md): Setup and development documentation.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/SubhakarKaarthi/flashex): Source code, issues, and releases.

## Important facts

- FlashEx supports Windows, macOS, and Linux through the Arduino IDE workflow.
- Arduino CLI must be available on the user's PATH.
- Generated code is a starting point and must be reviewed before production or safety-critical use.
- The current extension version shown on the website is 0.0.1.
